description: Partial containment for a documented HTTP exposure.
affected_versions: GPUStack before 2.2.0 with implicit loopback authentication enabled; fixed in 2.2.0.
coverage: Denies any client-supplied X-GPUStack-Real-IP header, including empty and non-loopback values, so alternate loopback encodings cannot bypass an address-specific signature.
limitations: Does not cover the independent same-host proxy TCP-loopback authentication bypass or a header inserted after WAF inspection. Set force_auth_localhost=true and upgrade; this header guard alone does not secure vulnerable GPUStack. Direct-origin access and alternate upstream path decoding remain outside this guard. Synthetic matcher tests are not a vulnerable-product exploit reproduction. Apply vendor fixes.
false_positive_risk: Rejects legitimate clients or trusted proxies supplying this header before Aegis. Remove it at the public ingress; do not expose the vulnerable API through a loopback-trusted proxy.
